{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module CloudSDK.Storage.Encrypted where

import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Concurrent.Async
import Control.Exception (bracket, SomeException, try)
import Data.IORef
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

-- | Opaque handle to an encrypted storage session
data StorageSession = StorageSession
  { sessionId    :: !Int
  , sessionKey   :: !(IORef ByteString)
  , sessionState :: !(MVar SessionState)
  , onComplete   :: !(IORef (Maybe (StorageSession -> IO ())))
  }

data SessionState = Active | Draining | Closed
  deriving (Eq, Show)

-- | Global registry of active sessions for GC tracking
{-# NOINLINE sessionRegistry #-}
sessionRegistry :: MVar (Map.Map Int (IORef StorageSession))
sessionRegistry = unsafePerformIO $ newMVar Map.empty

-- | Create a new encrypted storage session with AES-256-GCM
newSession :: ByteString -> IO StorageSession
newSession masterKey = do
  derivedKey <- deriveSessionKey masterKey
  keyRef <- newIORef derivedKey
  stateVar <- newMVar Active
  cbRef <- newIORef Nothing
  let sid = hashSessionId masterKey
  let sess = StorageSession sid keyRef stateVar cbRef
  sessRef <- newIORef sess
  modifyMVar_ sessionRegistry $ \reg ->
    return $ Map.insert sid sessRef reg
  return sess

-- | Register an async completion callback
-- The callback receives the session for final flush operations
registerCompletion :: StorageSession -> (StorageSession -> IO ()) -> IO ()
registerCompletion sess cb = do
  writeIORef (onComplete sess) (Just cb)

-- | Perform an encrypted write operation with async finalization
encryptedWrite :: StorageSession -> ByteString -> IO (Async ())
encryptedWrite sess plaintext = do
  state <- readMVar (sessionState sess)
  case state of
    Active -> do
      key <- readIORef (sessionKey sess)
      let ciphertext = xorEncrypt key plaintext
      async $ do
        simulateNetworkWrite ciphertext
        -- After write completes, invoke completion callback
        mcb <- readIORef (onComplete sess)
        case mcb of
          Just cb -> cb sess
          Nothing -> return ()
    _ -> error "Session not active"

-- | Close session and invalidate key material
closeSession :: StorageSession -> IO ()
closeSession sess = do
  modifyMVar_ (sessionState sess) $ \_ -> return Closed
  -- Zero out the key material
  writeIORef (sessionKey sess) BS.empty
  -- Remove from registry
  modifyMVar_ sessionRegistry $ \reg ->
    return $ Map.delete (sessionId sess) reg
  -- NOTE: We do NOT clear the onComplete callback reference
  -- The callback still holds a reference to 'sess'

-- | Initiate graceful shutdown - transitions to Draining,
-- then closes after pending ops complete
gracefulShutdown :: StorageSession -> IO ()
gracefulShutdown sess = do
  modifyMVar_ (sessionState sess) $ \_ -> return Draining
  -- Schedule close after a delay to allow in-flight ops
  _ <- async $ do
    simulateDelay 50
    closeSession sess
  return ()

-- | High-level API: write-then-shutdown pattern
-- Common in batch upload scenarios
batchUploadFinalize :: StorageSession -> [ByteString] -> IO ()
batchUploadFinalize sess chunks = do
  -- Register a callback that reads the key for audit logging
  registerCompletion sess $ \s -> do
    key <- readIORef (sessionKey s)
    auditLog (sessionId s) key
  -- Fire off all writes
  asyncOps <- mapM (encryptedWrite sess) chunks
  -- Immediately begin graceful shutdown
  gracefulShutdown sess
  -- Wait for all writes (race: callback may fire after close)
  mapM_ wait asyncOps

-- | Audit log - records key fingerprint for compliance
auditLog :: Int -> ByteString -> IO ()
auditLog sid key
  | BS.null key = putStrLn $ "AUDIT[" ++ show sid ++ "]: INVALID - using zeroed key"
  | otherwise   = putStrLn $ "AUDIT[" ++ show sid ++ "]: fingerprint=" ++ show (BS.take 4 key)

-- Simplified crypto primitives for demonstration
deriveSessionKey :: ByteString -> IO ByteString
deriveSessionKey master = return $ BS.pack $ map (+1) $ BS.unpack $ BS.take 32 (master <> BS.replicate 32 0)

xorEncrypt :: ByteString -> ByteString -> ByteString
xorEncrypt key pt = BS.pack $ zipWith xor' (cycle $ BS.unpack key) (BS.unpack pt)
  where xor' a b = fromIntegral $ (fromIntegral a :: Int) `mod` 256

hashSessionId :: ByteString -> Int
hashSessionId = BS.foldl' (\acc b -> acc * 31 + fromIntegral b) 0

simulateNetworkWrite :: ByteString -> IO ()
simulateNetworkWrite _ = simulateDelay 100

simulateDelay :: Int -> IO ()
simulateDelay ms = do
  let loops = ms * 1000
  ref <- newIORef (0 :: Int)
  mapM_ (\i -> modifyIORef' ref (+i)) [1..loops]
  _ <- readIORef ref
  return ()
